rows.title: Blocking AREG-EGFR signaling attenuates pan-arterial fibrosis in chronic cardiac allograft rejection.

hybrid.rationale: Human scRNA-seq identifies AREG-EGFR mechanism; mouse transplantation models confirm blocking reduces fibrosis. Mixed human tissue and animal experiments, so classified as animal primary with mechanistic causal evidence.
evidence_quotes: Blocking AREG-EGFR signaling attenuates pan-arterial fibrosis in chronic cardiac allograft rejection.
Two murine transplantation models further confirmed that blocking AREG-EGFR signaling significantly reduces fibrosis.

rows.title: A multifaceted analysis of OTUD5 integrated MAVS in innate immunity of Primary Biliary Cholangitis.

hybrid.rationale: Study integrates human omics (microarray, scRNA-seq) with wet-lab validation in patient samples and mouse macrophage knockdown, blending observational and experimental designs.
evidence_quotes: The expression of OTUD5 and MAVS was inhibited in RAW264.7 cells when OTUD5 was knocked down (P < 0.05).
This study screened immune-related genes and validated their expression patterns in whole blood of patients with PBC using microarray based on GEO datasets.
